prompt: The client wants to know which of our two pending acquisitions carries the larger indemnity escrow: the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics deal or the Halden Bay / Orlyn Foods deal. Query the matter documents and read in full the execution version of each stock purchase agreement — read the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics agreement first, then the Halden Bay / Orlyn Foods agreement. Compare the Indemnity Escrow Amounts stated in the two executed agreements (ignore drafts, the LOI, and the email thread). Then (1) record a matter review on legal_matters_001 with reviewer_role set exactly to 'deal_comparison_analyst' and outcome set to exactly one slug from this list: 'higher_escrow_meridian_corvess' if the Meridian/Corvess agreement has the larger indemnity escrow, 'higher_escrow_halden_orlyn' if the Halden Bay/Orlyn agreement does, or 'escrow_amounts_equal' if they match; and (2) record the larger of the two indemnity escrow amounts as an amount-history entry on billing file legal_billing_001 with invoice_amount set to that exact dollar amount (plain number) and changed_by_role set exactly to 'deal_comparison_analyst'.
goal: Compare indemnity escrow amounts across the two executed SPAs, classify which is higher, and record the higher amount.
steps: Locate the input documents for this engagement in the matter folder
Read every required input document in full
Derive the graded determinations strictly from the documents
Record the determinations with the required write tools
